div.div:
1. Center firewall evaluates top-down: CC-GST denies first, CC-DEF-01 denies and logs the rest.
2. Cloud uses TGW routes, NACLs, security groups and endpoint policies; no NAT, no Network Firewall.
3. Temporary rules to audit: CC-LNK-06 / CL-LNK-05 (qa), CC-ADM-05, CC-ADM-06.
4. Solid = permanent allow; dashed amber = temporary or backup; dashed red = deny or blackhole; dashed grey = reserved.
